title: The structural basis of TRIM25-mediated regulation of RIG-I.
authors: Li, Yunlong; Wu, Siqi; Tian, Xuyang; Kong, Chen; Hong, Wenbin; Xiao, Tianyichen; Wang, Songqing; Wei, Zhiming; Su, Zhiming; Ren, Haixia; Song, Yunlong; Hu, Lichen; Lin, Donghai; Yao, Hongwei; Han, Jiahuai; Chen, Xueqin; Lin, Tianwei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究TRIM25与RIG-I蛋白间的结构互作，虽涉及计算机辅助建模，但对象为蛋白-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联度低。
abstract: TRIM25, an E3 ligase, is an important regulator to modulate the functions of retinoic acid inducible gene-I (RIG-I) and other factors in innate immunity. Herein the structural interaction between the 2CARD domain of RIG-I and the PRYSPRY domain of TRIM25 was investigated by NMR, X-ray crystallography, computer-assisted modeling, and cell-based assays to elucidate the complex structure of PRYSPRY/2CARD. The interacting model indicated that docking of 2CARD onto PRYSPRY brought two RIG-I molecules into a close proximity to form a dimer. The attachment of a short ubiquitin chain covalently by the TRIM25's E3 ligase activity was favorable for tethering a neighboring RIG-I dimer to form the tetrameric RIG-I by noncovalent interactions. The data supported the notion that the TRIM25-RIG-I interaction was important to activate the RIG-I pathway to suppress the replication of RNA viruses, such as vesicular stomatitis virus. This work provides a structural rationale to delineate the underlying mechanism of TRIM25 regulation of RIG-I.
abstract_zh: TRIM25作为一种E3连接酶，是调节维甲酸诱导基因I（RIG-I）及先天免疫中其他因子功能的重要调控因子。本研究通过核磁共振（NMR）、X射线晶体学、计算机辅助建模及细胞实验，探究了RIG-I的2CARD结构域与TRIM25的PRYSPRY结构域之间的结构相互作用，以阐明PRYSPRY/2CARD复合物结构。相互作用模型表明，2CARD对接至PRYSPRY使两个RIG-I分子紧密接近，形成二聚体。TRIM25的E3连接酶活性共价连接短泛素链，有利于通过非共价相互作用锚定邻近的RIG-I二聚体，形成四聚体RIG-I。数据支持TRIM25-RIG-I相互作用对激活RIG-I通路以抑制RNA病毒（如水疱性口炎病毒）复制至关重要。本研究为阐明TRIM25调控RIG-I的潜在机制提供了结构依据。
